newsitem.title: USA: Outlook Group looks for profit in FY98.
newsitem.headline: Outlook Group looks for profit in FY98.

text.p: Outlook Group Corp said Thursday it is working on plans to emphasize continued cost reductions and to build sales, a strategy it expects will lead to profitability in fiscal 1998.
"With a successful implementation of these plans, we anticipate a return to profitability in fiscal 1998," said chairman David Erdmann in a statement.
The graphic services and packaging company reported a loss for the February 28 third quarter of $0.07 per share compared with a year-before loss of $0.25 per share.
Erdmann said the company expects to announce shortly a buyer for its Outlook Foods subsidiary.
Outlook Group also expects to close in late March or early April on the sale of its Barrier Films subsidiary to World Class Film Corp.
